scheduler: No scheduled or manual GitHub vacancy scans. ChatGPT vacancy-search is the sole user-facing on-demand entrypoint; GitHub Actions only runs offline CI.
jobicy_fallback_policy: REST primary; public RSS fallback is limited to expected transport failures or malformed provider payloads. Unexpected adapter/programming errors fail visibly. Optional targeted HEAD checks treat only 404/410 as closed.
technical_state: Optional SQLite state is temporary and local to an explicitly requested acquisition run; older GitHub radar-state and ingestion-state are no longer runtime sources.
vacancy_snapshot_history: SQLite job_snapshots keyed by job_id + content_hash
semantic_review_handoff: Only explicitly initiated ChatGPT vacature-search requests may use public technical observations; specialist verifies official employer/ATS evidence and deduplicates against the live Vacature Register. No background queue.
register_sync: Reads only the current active-source status from the live Vacature Register > Bronnen; no automatic source-health or Runs writes.
target_runtime_gate: The active-source Register check is mandatory for live scans; an optional free SerpApi account may be verified without spending search credits.
release_evidence: Reproducible source bundle, SPDX SBOM and tests can be produced locally; pull-request CI tests do not constitute a production end-to-end scan.
source_specs: deploy.json and google-optional.json are technical adapter targets only, filtered against live Vacature Register Bronnen.
